title: Exact34 Positive Progress modeled history included in native Paper statistics
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Восстанови историю по всем добавленным Loss Diff Progress стратегиям
Начинаем с нуля, потом восстановим историю отдельной командой

Смоделируй Progress стратегию для Loss Diff Positive для ETH Up or Down 5m Up 4 bps Reference Average Premarket, при которой размер ставки умножается на текущий Loss Diff.  Учитывай именно Net Pnl, то есть с комиссией Polymarket

Теперь для той же стратегии повтори эти же рассчёты для N случаев, где N от 1 до 15 (для 16 у нас уже есть) и N - это ограничитель максимального коэффициента. То есть при N = 5 и LossDiff = 12, умножаем всё равно на 5
Теперь повтори это для второй стратегии, только N до 18
Делаем допущение, что стакан был достаточно глубокий, чтобы вся ставка была сделана по одинаковой цене. Это решит проблему?
Что такое `ResearchOnly`  ? Мы сможем рассчитать Net Pnl и Net Roi ?
Мне нужна история в приложении в том виде, как будто это родная история, а не восстановленная
Да, восстановленные сделки должны также входить в обычные показатели. И потом отдельно расскажи мне, сколько у нас `ResearchOnly` сделок, которые сейчас не входят в статистику

requirements.text: Использовать согласованную модель полного исполнения увеличенной ставки по средней цене родителя.
requirements.sourceQuote: стакан был достаточно глубокий, чтобы вся ставка была сделана по одинаковой цене
acceptanceCriteria: Research/model premise: enough liquidity for the entire modeled child amount at the parent's average executed price, no additional slippage/partial fills/retries. Every cap is an independent strategy, not a shared liquidity pool across all34.

Multiplier m=min(pre-entry Positive LossDiff,cap). Base amount is the parent's actual invested notional excluding fees, not its configured stake or unused order remainder. Exact scaling/price precision and no additional venue normalization are explicit ASM-002.

Child spent notional=parent invested notional*m; child shares=parent actual filled shares*m. Model average price is parent actual invested notional/parent actual filled shares, retained at calculation precision, with numeric18,8 display/storage price and numeric28,8 amounts. Prove agreement of parent run/fill/settlement amounts at their stored precision before using them. Never reinterpret a rounded display price as a different stake.

Derive child payout from verified parent selected-token settlement price/outcome and child shares; derive Gross=payout-spent. Do not multiply a stored parent Gross or Net as the implementation shortcut. Rounded financial identities must agree in all persisted records; explicit rounding tests cover storage precision.

Create native accepted signal, Filled Buy Paper order, fill, Settled run, closed zero-size position and settlement. Use execution_source='eth_lossdiff_positive_progress_history_research_paper' and evidence version='eth_progress34_parent_average_full_fill_history_v1', not fake evidence of independent frozen-book execution.

Keep actual historical market/entry/fill/settlement times for native history and separately retain reconstructed_at_utc, source IDs/digests, parent amount/average price, k/cap/m, model assumption, ResearchOnly provenance, this approved exception ID/digest and ordinary_paper_metrics_included=true. If old book evidence exists it is retained as parent evidence, never claimed to prove the enlarged fill; never generate fictional snapshots.

verification.expected: Full-fill model independent hand calculations for loss/win, repeated caps, mixed-price parent VWAP, rounding, missing book, overlapping settlements; no venue/network/order operation or runtime strategy change.

Native six-record chain consistent at DB precision; history effective dates and explicit reconstruction provenance both preserved, positions closed, no fictional child depth; current actual-depth Positive Progress tests unchanged and passing.

requirements.text: Пересчитать комиссию, Net PnL и Net ROI для восстановленных увеличенных ставок.
requirements.sourceQuote: Учитывай именно Net Pnl, то есть с комиссией Polymarket
acceptanceCriteria: Use each candidate parent's recorded complete market fee schedule and provenance for the same condition, and recalculate via existing PolymarketFeeCalculator for modeled child shares and the model average price. Own fee is rounded5 AwayFromZero by that calculator; never multiply the parent's already rounded fee/Net or coerce a missing fee to zero.

All1882 candidate parent entries currently have Calculated/Taker,r0.07,e1,taker_onlytrue. Of these1054 (664 Up4+390 Up8) carry historical-current-paper-model-v1:polymarket-clob-v2-fd-shares-rate-price-curve-round5-away-from-zero-v1;828 (468+360) carry the unprefixed calculator source. ASM-003 explicitly accepts this recorded retrospective modeled tariff without claiming actual historical venue charges.

Child fee status Calculated, never VenueReported. Preserve rate/exponent/taker-only/role, parent fee provenance, new calculation timestamp and evidence. No fetching today's fee schedule to replace recorded inputs; no donor/fixed3.33-point policy.

Net=payout-spent-fee. Aggregate Net ROI=100*sum(Net)/(sum(spent)+sum(fee)) for the exact modeled settled scope. Native accounting records and normal projections must reconcile; preserve current Gross and Net field meanings, not a new ROI denominator.

Independently recompute per-cap trade/win/loss counts, stake, payouts, fees, Gross and Net from persisted exact-manifest rows and compare to the frozen decimal plan. Verify ordinary projection Net/counts include the inserted contribution without confusing organic concurrent trades with command writes.
